title: Row of vertical tubular level/flow assemblies with valves
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.

Five vertical tubular assemblies are visible across the image; each assembly consists of a top flange, multiple long vertical metal support rods, a clear vertical sight tube or gauge inside the rods, and a bottom flange. The assemblies are cropped at the top and bottom edges in places.

Four red handwheel valve handles are visible along the lower front edge; they are mounted on valves or valves with short connecting pipes. The valves are distributed roughly under the second through fifth assemblies from the left (count based on visible portion).
At least three flexible braided metal hoses or braided connectors are visible at the bottom connecting to the lower flanges/valves; some hoses are partially obscured behind other fittings.
Multiple round metal flange bolts and nuts are present on each top and bottom flange; each visible flange shows at least four large hexagonal nuts/bolts.
A horizontal perforated orange metal rack or shelving upright is visible at left and running along the bottom; the tubular assemblies are mounted above or in front of it.
A short length of white insulated cable or conduit runs horizontally behind the assemblies, visible near mid-height of the image.
spatial_relations: The tubular assemblies are arranged in a horizontal row from left to right and appear mounted to a horizontal support or beam near their top flanges.
Each assembly has multiple long vertical metal support rods surrounding a central clear sight tube; the rods connect the top flange to the bottom flange making each assembly a vertical column.

The red handwheel valves are located below the bottom flanges and are connected to the lower piping; the braided hoses connect between those lower flange regions and a lower horizontal manifold or piping.
A perforated orange vertical rack/member is visible at the far left and supports or frames the lower piping area; a gray panel or sheet is behind the assemblies forming a vertical background.
Clear sight tubes run inside the rod assemblies and are parallel to each other; some sight tubes show internal scale markings but these are not legible.
colours_and_materials: Support rods and flange hardware appear grey/blue painted metal with some visible rust and corrosion at joints.
Top flange faces are metallic silver/bright metal; some top flanges have a brass-colored fitting or connector on top.
Sight tubes are transparent (glass or clear plastic) allowing internal view; some tubes contain a narrow internal float or internal rod with discoloured residue.
Valve handwheels are red-painted metal, distinct from surrounding hardware.
Braided hoses are metallic silver with woven texture; some short pipe sections and fittings are brass-coloured.
The floor or lower surface visible at the bottom is blue.
uncertainties: Exact count of assemblies could be affected by cropping at left and right edges; I report five visible across the image but additional assemblies may extend beyond the frame.
Some braided hoses and fittings are partially obscured behind other parts so the count of hoses (reported as at least three) is a visible minimum not necessarily the full set present.

No legible textual labels, room names or equipment nameplates could be read in the image; small stickers or markings (including green circular stickers) are visible but contain no readable text at this resolution.
The precise type or function of these assemblies (e.g., level gauge, flowmeter) is not determined from appearance and is not inferred here.
Positions described (e.g., 'second through fifth assemblies from the left') are relative to the visible portion of the image and may shift if cropped differently.
